dependent_averaging_gap.hypotheses: (E) shift-ergodic stationary path law with initial law << invariant law gives almost-sure limits for all six estimator families; (D) one-step minorization gives almost-sure limits from every start and the normal limits for ordinary, self-normalized, harmonic, pr3 and latent averages with variance sigma^2_K. No normal limit asserted under (E) alone, nor for bridge or pr4 (none asserted for their independent versions).

adaptive_quadrature_gap.error_statement: Q_{n,1} = Laplace value; I_n/Q_{n,K} = 1 + O(1/n) under def:p15-laplace-family; under C^6/C^4 bounds I_n/Q_{n,K} = 1 + Delta_{n,K}/n + O(n^-2), Delta = 0 for K >= 4; worked boundary: gamma integral Delta = 1/12, 5/18, 1/3, 0, and a second mode violating the tail condition gives ratio -> 2 for every K

optimal_bridge_gap.optimality: minimizes the variance V(alpha) of the normal limit of the relative error among square-integrable bridge functions at fixed allocation (s1, s2), independent samples; optimum alpha_r = 1/(s1 q1 + s2 r q2) up to a nonzero constant on {q1 q2 > 0}; iteration converges from every start to the unique root of a strictly increasing estimating function, geometrically on the log scale; the fixed point is strongly consistent with the optimal limit variance
